description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigAPI class, a REST API controller handling database configuration requests for the OrangeHRM installer. It provides endpoints for retrieving and setting database connection info during setup, including handling new and existing database scenarios with various validation steps.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing database configuration during installation, supporting both new and existing database setups with validation and error handling.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to configure database settings, validating parameters, establishing database connections, checking database existence and user validity, and returning configuration data or errors.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current database configuration details stored in the session/state container.
